releaseNotes: Added two native Android Home Screen Widgets: Compact Action Bar (4x2) and Spend & Active Shopping List (4x3), automatically synced with Flow Dark, Premium Black, and Light themes plus real-time Room database updates.

Added 1-tap transparent Quick Expense & Income overlays, Voice Shopping List capture (natural spoken/typed item + quantity parsing via VoiceShoppingParser into Room v5 shopping_items), and focus-aware clipboard Smart Paste routing verified alerts to Pending Review.
Enabled direct home screen shopping checklist toggling without opening the app, Mask Balances lock-screen auto-redaction (with opt-in Settings toggle), and Android 12+ live widget picker previews.
